card.name: Linking words before "the" in labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, with, to, of, on) in prescribing-information text, right where the next word is likely to be "the" or a specific clinical term. Mostly appears in monitoring, dose-adjustment and warning sentences.

modes.label: Conjunction joining actions
modes.description: "and" or a comma joining two clauses or items in monitoring or warning text.
modes.example: Frequent monitoring of cyclosporine whole blood trough concentrations should be performed during and at discontinuation of posaconazole treatment<< and>> the cyclosporine dosage should

modes.label: Preposition before the
modes.description: Prepositions such as with, to, of, on that follow a noun or adjective and precede "the".
modes.example: decrease the P-gp or BCRP substrate dosage in accordance<< with>> the approved prescribing information.

card.writes: Promotes generic sentence-continuation and connector tokens, mostly in Chinese and other languages, with no clear link to the drug text.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in label instructions, just before the sentence names what to monitor or adjust.
